The record for Evidence-Chain Reliable RAG: Word-Level Hallucination Detection, Source Attribution, and Provenance Explanation for LLM Applications reports: authors family: Chenyu Li; sequence: first; role: vocabulary: crossref; role: author; family: Jingwen Bai; sequence: additional; role: vocabulary: crossref; role: author; family: Samuel Wang; sequence: additional; role: vocabulary: crossref; role: author.
The record for Evidence-Chain Reliable RAG: Word-Level Hallucination Detection, Source Attribution, and Provenance Explanation for LLM Applications states in its own abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) reduces unsupported generation by conditioning a language model on external evidence, yet generated answers can still contain factual claims that are absent from or contradicted by the retrieved source.
The record for Evidence-Chain Reliable RAG: Word-Level Hallucination Detection, Source Attribution, and Provenance Explanation for LLM Applications states in its own abstract: This paper presents an evidence-chain detector for reliable RAG applications.
The record for Evidence-Chain Reliable RAG: Word-Level Hallucination Detection, Source Attribution, and Provenance Explanation for LLM Applications states in its own abstract: The detector aligns a generated answer with retrieved passages or structured records, computes lexical, sparse retrieval, and rule-based entailment features, and predicts hallucination at word and sentence level while returning the evidence chunk used for attribution.
The record for Evidence-Chain Reliable RAG: Word-Level Hallucination Detection, Source Attribution, and Provenance Explanation for LLM Applications states in its own abstract: To avoid illustrative reporting, all numerical results in this manuscript were produced by the packaged experiment script with random seed 17.
The record for Evidence-Chain Reliable RAG: Word-Level Hallucination Detection, Source Attribution, and Provenance Explanation for LLM Applications states in its own abstract: The execution artifact contains a RAGTruth-compatible audit corpus with 140 source items, six generated-style responses per source, 840 responses, 2,250 sentences, and 23,284 evaluated word tokens.
The record for Evidence-Chain Reliable RAG: Word-Level Hallucination Detection, Source Attribution, and Provenance Explanation for LLM Applications states in its own abstract: The test split contains 252 responses and 286 hallucinated tokens.
The record for Evidence-Chain Reliable RAG: Word-Level Hallucination Detection, Source Attribution, and Provenance Explanation for LLM Applications states in its own abstract: EvidenceChain-RF achieved the strongest measured word-level score, with precision 0.468, recall 0.654, F1 0.545, ROC-AUC 0.919, and PR-AUC 0.357.
The record for Evidence-Chain Reliable RAG: Word-Level Hallucination Detection, Source Attribution, and Provenance Explanation for LLM Applications states in its own abstract: At sentence level, the same detector reached precision 0.952, recall 1.000, and F1 0.975.
The record for Evidence-Chain Reliable RAG: Word-Level Hallucination Detection, Source Attribution, and Provenance Explanation for LLM Applications states in its own abstract: The results show that explicit evidence matching, mismatch features, and supervised calibration provide more reliable span detection than lexical overlap alone.
The record for Evidence-Chain Reliable RAG: Word-Level Hallucination Detection, Source Attribution, and Provenance Explanation for LLM Applications states in its own abstract: The package also includes an official-schema loader for response.jsonl and source_info.jsonl, allowing the same code to rerun on the complete public RAGTruth release when those files are available in the execution environment.
